up: Show all IC50 activity records for CHEMBL5498743 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL612267. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard relation, standard value, standard units, assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, and the document PubMed ID or DOI.
sql:
WITH target_assays AS (
    SELECT assay_id
    FROM assays
    WHERE tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL612267')
), compound_set AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno, parent.chembl_id, parent.pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
    UNION
    SELECT child.molregno, child.chembl_id, child.pref_name
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    JOIN molecule_hierarchy mh ON mh.parent_molregno = parent.molregno
    JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5498743'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    cs.molregno,
    md.chembl_id,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    assays.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    assays.description,
    COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM compound_set md
JOIN activities a ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN target_assays ta ON a.assay_id = ta.assay_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN assays ON assays.assay_id = a.assay_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON d.doc_id = a.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
